WE ARE LOOKING FOR YOU AS

PRODUCT SOFTWARE ENGINEER (BACK END PHP) (M/W/D)

LIMITED IN COLOGNE

Interzero is one of the leading service providers in closing product, material, and logistics cycles and a pioneer in plastics recycling, operating Europe’s largest sorting capacity. Guided by the principle of “zero waste solutions,” the company supports more than 80,000 customers across Europe in the responsible handling of recyclable materials, helping them improve their sustainability performance and conserve primary  resources. With around 2,000 employees, Interzero generates annual revenues of nearly one billion euros. According to Fraunhofer UMSICHT, Interzero’s recycling activities alone saved approximately 1.04 million tons of greenhouse gas emissions and 8.09 million tons of primary raw  materials compared to primary production in 2024. Further information at: www.interzero.de.

What is it about?

- Innovation: You are motivated to transform one of the oldest industries from the ground up.
- Development: You are responsible for the independent, goal-oriented development of complex web applications and services based on modern, lightweight architectures using PHP, SQL, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
- Project Ownership: After a comprehensive onboarding phase, you take ownership of the technical implementation of innovative projects and actively contribute to the further development and maintenance of existing systems.
- Full Stack: You develop and maintain both frontend and backend applications.
- Focus: Your main focus is on web shop solutions (Magento) and logistics applications based on Laravel.

Advantages:

- Job Security: You can expect a varied, exciting, and secure role with one of the largest environmental service providers in a future-proof industry.
- Compensation: You receive performance-based pay with a strong focus on maintaining your work-life balance.
- Flexibility: You benefit from flexible working hours and the option to work remotely.
- Creative Freedom: You work in an environment where ideas, initiative, and creative freedom are encouraged and supported.
- Flat Hierarchies: You operate within flat hierarchies and quickly take on responsibility for your own tasks.
- Collaboration: You experience a culture of collaboration and respect at eye level, both within and beyond your team.
- Development: You have access to internal and external training and development opportunities.
- Health: You benefit from a comprehensive health management program.
- Benefits: You receive attractive perks such as corporate benefits, bike leasing, free drinks and fruit on-site, and coverage of the Germany ticket or an Edenred card.

Profile:

- Education & Experience: You have completed training as an application development specialist, a degree in computer science, or have several years of proven experience as a PHP developer.
- Technical Skills: You possess strong knowledge of web technologies such as PHP 7, MariaDB 10, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Tools & Frameworks: You have experience working with version control systems (Git) and Atlassian tools, and ideally bring initial experience with Magento 2.x and Laravel 5.x.
- Working Style: You handle projects with a high level of accuracy and responsibility and impress with your structured and solution-oriented approach.
- Languages: You are fluent in German, both written and spoken, and have good English skills.
- Analytical Skills & Independence: You complement your profile with independent working skills and strong analytical thinking.

Contact:

Yannick Bartsch

hr@interzero.de

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber: 
Grundkenntnisse: Versionsverwaltungsprogramm Git
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Projektmanagement, Web-Applikationen (Entwicklung, Programmierung), Programmiersprache PHP

This is Worldline.

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an Accountant to join our Group Accounting team in a role at the heart of our operations. You will work closely with operational teams, monitor key topics directly linked to business performance and development, and build strong relationships with PMOs and key partners across the organization.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Working closely with the Finance department and all financial functions of the Group (Order-to-Cash teams, Business Controllers, Consolidation, Finance Management, Treasury, etc.), you will be responsible for the following tasks:

- Perform daily accounting activities: bank operations, purchases, sales, payroll, VAT, and general accounting, including analytical coding of entries.
- Process financial transactions: verification, classification, calculation, accounting and data entry.
- Prepare supplier payment runs according to deadlines (twice per month).
- Monitor and reconcile customer and supplier accounts regularly.
- Work with the FBO teams to ensure timely customer billing.
- Participate in monthly, quarterly and annual closings under IFRS and local GAAP.
- Produce regulatory reporting in accordance with local standards for tax authorities, and possibly central banks and works councils (monthly, quarterly and/or annually).
- Reconcile and justify open balance sheet items and participate in closing and balance sheet review meetings.
- Prepare and file statutory taxes: VAT, Corporate Income Tax, Environmental Taxes and other local taxes.
- Align monthly with the Consolidation team to validate intercompany positions (balance sheet and P&L) and prepare IFRS management reporting for consolidation purposes.
- Collaborate with Finance teams: Finance Business Operations, controlling, consolidation, treasury and other departments.
- Work with fiduciaries and consultants on local and international reporting.
- Manage relationships with external auditors and support internal and tax audits.
- Contribute to the design, maintenance and management of the internal control framework for existing and new activities.
- Continuously improve reporting processes and accounting controls.
- Ensure adherence to internal accounting policies.

Who Are We Looking For

We are seeking individuals capable of driving positive change—people who are proactive, passionate and ready to take initiative. In practice, this means:

- Minimum 3–4 years of experience in general accounting, either in a company or an audit firm.
- Autonomy in managing daily accounting tasks and standard tax declarations (especially VAT).
- Bachelor’s degree required.
- Strong rigor, analytical skills and the ability to structure complex topics.
- Ability to work independently while meeting strict deadlines.
- Capacity to translate business needs for internal stakeholders.
- Proficiency in English (an additional language is a plus).
- Willingness to learn more about accounting, tax and reporting.
- Solid command of Excel and SAP

What we offer

- Growth: The opportunity to progress in a fast-growing environment.
- Culture: Join a team that values proximity and entrepreneurial spirit.

Shape the evolution.

We are pushing towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers to join our journey. People with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you’ll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. And with our empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career. Wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of over 18,000 innovators across 40+ countries, and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.

Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com (https://jobs.worldline.com/)

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

YOUR SHOES TO FILL:

- Support and drive Identity & Access Management (IAM) and User Access Management (UAM) activities, including access provisioning, access modifications, and periodic access reviews.
- Perform compliance and control-related activities in line with SOX, ISO, and IT governance requirements, and support the testing of control effectiveness.
- Identify control gaps, coordinate remediation activities, and ensure accurate, traceable, and audit-ready documentation.
- Support internal and external audits by providing required evidence, documentation, and information.
- Analyze existing IAM processes and contribute to their continuous improvement and automation.
- Partner with business stakeholders, application owners, and technical teams to define access requirements and implement secure and compliant access management practices.
- Support users, entities, and teams with IAM-related requests and inquiries through the ticketing system.

YOUR WALK OF LIFE:

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Business Informatics, or a related field; alternatively, completed vocational training in IT or equivalent practical experience.
- Initial to several years of professional experience in Identity & Access Management, IT Security, IT Governance, Compliance, or related IT functions.
- Good understanding of IAM and UAM concepts, including identity lifecycle management, Joiner-Mover-Leaver processes, access management, and access reviews.
- Experience with Microsoft Entra ID; knowledge of Entra ID Governance, Entitlement Management, or Lifecycle Workflows is an advantage.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and hands-on experience using service management and ticketing systems.
- Understanding of role-based access control (RBAC), least-privilege principles, privileged access management, and administrative access concepts.
- Familiarity with compliance, risk, and control frameworks such as SOX, ISO, ITGC, or NIST is a plus.
- Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to create and maintain clear, structured, and auditable documentation.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills when working with business stakeholders, audit teams, and IT colleagues.
- Professional proficiency in both English and German (minimum B2 level); relevant certifications such as Microsoft SC-300, ITIL, CISA, or CISM are considered a plus.

WE OFFER:

BIRKENSTOCK offers you all the advantages of a successful, fast growing, global company: dynamic work environment, considerable design freedom, authentic and open corporate culture and excellent development opportunities. Sounds exciting? It is. Our Talent Acquisition team is looking forward to receiving your online application!

If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in.

At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.
We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
Surventis became an independent company on 30 June 2026. The Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) is a member of the Executive Committee and is responsible for enterprise transformation, value creation and execution across all businesses and functions. The Executive Assistant runs the Office of the CTO. You make sure the CTO's time goes to the decisions that matter, that every management meeting is prepared to a board standard, and that agreed actions actually get done. You also take on selected project work.

- In your role, you help to ensure that the CTO is well prepared for daily priorities by coordinating schedules, organizing meetings and serving as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
- Together with the CTO and the Value Creation & Delivery leadership team, you maintain an overview of commitments, actions and follow-up activities to support transparent and effective collaboration.
- Working closely with leaders and business functions, you prepare leadership and management meetings to a high standard, coordinate decision papers and document outcomes and next steps clearly and concisely.
- You contribute to selected transformation and strategy initiatives by organizing information, preparing analyses and creating executive summaries that support informed decision-making.
- You also play an important role in bringing people together by coordinating workshops, leadership off-sites, site visits, internal communications and external advisor engagements.
- university degree in business administration, economics, engineering or a comparable field, or an equivalent qualification
- at least five years of experience supporting a board member, CEO or executive leader, or experience in consulting, project management, strategy or transformation environments
- strong Microsoft 365 skills, especially PowerPoint and Excel, along with confidence using modern productivity and AI tools
- fluent German and English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate effectively across diverse stakeholder groups
- a collaborative, well-organized and dependable working style combined with empathy, strong communication skills, sound judgment and a commitment to high-quality outcomes

WHAT WE OFFER

- We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan offer comprehensive coverage.
- We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development.
- The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g., through regular employee surveys and management feedback.
- At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio "Freizeit" with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant "Auszeit" including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center "LackiKids" and a vacation program "LackiKids on Tour".

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.

Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. In addition, CDD offers advanced laboratory instrumentation and high-throughput automation solutions for a wide range of clinical laboratory environments.

Our products and solutions are delivered through direct sales, regional distributors and OEM partnerships.

Territory: Eastern & Central Germany
ZIP Codes: 01, 02, 04, 06, 07, 08, 09, 30, 31, 32, 34, 36, 37, 38, 99
Field-based / Remote within the territory

Discover Impactful Work

We are looking for an experienced Account Manager (m/f/d) – Clinical Diagnostics to drive commercial growth across Eastern and Central Germany.

In this field-based role, you will take ownership of a strategically important sales territory, developing existing customer relationships while identifying and winning new business opportunities.

As a trusted advisor to clinical laboratories and healthcare customers, you will combine your scientific understanding with a consultative sales approach to identify customer needs, understand laboratory workflows and develop solutions that deliver measurable value.

You will work closely with customers, key decision-makers and internal cross-functional teams to expand our market presence, increase revenue and strengthen long-term partnerships.

A Day in the Life

- Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans to achieve or exceed annual sales targets
- Take full ownership of revenue growth, pipeline development and commercial performance within the assigned territory
- Manage, develop and grow relationships with existing key accounts
- Identify, qualify and convert new business opportunities within clinical laboratories and other relevant customer segments
- Build strong relationships with laboratory managers, clinicians, procurement teams, technical specialists and other key decision-makers
- Apply a consultative selling approach to understand customer applications, workflows, challenges and future requirements
- Position Thermo Fisher Scientific’s clinical diagnostic solutions effectively and develop compelling value propositions
- Manage the complete sales cycle, from opportunity identification and customer engagement through negotiation and closing
- Collaborate closely with Applications, Technical Service, Marketing, Customer Service and other commercial teams to deliver an outstanding customer experience
- Maintain an accurate and high-quality sales pipeline, forecast and customer data within Salesforce
- Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer developments to identify new growth opportunities
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at customer meetings, industry events, conferences and exhibitions
- Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and develop sustainable, long-term business partnerships

Keys to Success

You combine a strong scientific or technical background with commercial drive and a genuine passion for understanding and solving customer challenges.

You are comfortable managing a large territory independently, identifying growth opportunities and engaging with stakeholders at different levels of an organization. At the same time, you enjoy working collaboratively within a global, cross-functional organization.

Education & Experience

- Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Biology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Medical Technology or another relevant scientific discipline
- Minimum 5 years of successful sales experience, preferably within clinical diagnostics, IVD, laboratory solutions, life sciences, medical technology or healthcare
- Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets and developing a sales territory
- Experience managing complex customer relationships and sales cycles
- Experience working with clinical laboratories, hospitals or other diagnostic customers is highly desirable

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Strong technical and scientific understanding, with the ability to quickly understand customer applications and laboratory workflows
- Excellent consultative selling, communication, presentation and negotiation skills
- Strong commercial mindset with the ability to identify and develop new business opportunities
- Demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships with customers and key decision-makers
- Strong analytical, strategic planning and territory management capabilities
- Results-oriented, proactive and accountable approach to sales
- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional and matrix organization
- Proficiency with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, and Microsoft Office applications
- Valid driver’s license
- Willingness to travel approximately 50–75% within the assigned territory

Language Requirements

- Fluent German is essential (C1 level or above)
- Strong professional English skills are required for communication within our international organization

Benefits:
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch (https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/5-reasons-to-work-at-thermo-fisher-scientific)  as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific (https://corporate.thermofisher.com/us/en/index.html) , where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Soldering operator

Working as as soldering operator at Benchmark means making solder joints, both mechanically as manually.

As a solder operator at Benchmark you are responsible for manually placing components on prints. When necessary you check, and touch-up, prints. Your experience and skills help you on a daily basis to make additional or changed connections.

Your tasks are, amongst others:

· Visually checking the PCB with the help of digital instructions and technical drawings

· Determining the process, together with manufacturing engineers, for (process) parameters for the series

· Identifying deviations from the predetermined standards

· Soldering, touch-op and outcoming goods inspection

You will work with different kind of toolings, such as: soldering iron, hot plates and/or dryers. It is a very precise job where you will be working via a microscope or dynascope.

What Benchmark has to offer to you:

· A salary between € 2,751 - € 3,292 gross per month based on 40 hour workweek, depending on your knowledge and experience.

· Broad development opportunities with the help of our Benchmark Academy.

· Entrepreneurship is seen, valued and encouraged.

· BeFit program: stay fit by exercising weekly with your colleagues or participating in sporting events.

· A turnover-related quarterly bonus that can amount to 5%. This percentage may vary.

· 40 vacation days during the year, when you are working on a full-time basis.

What do we ask of you?

· Experience as a soldering operator or experience with a micro-soldering.

· Being able to work very precise and accurate.

· Being able to read and follow technical drawings/work instructions.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our global and diverse Gas Services (GS) organization, where putting the customer at the heart of every decision and continuously improving how we operate are the foundation of quality. Quality is more than reporting, firefighting, and correcting issues after the fact — it is about turning experience into sustainable learning and lasting improvement.
As Service Quality Professional you will act as a trusted partner and point of contact for our Regional Service Unit (RSU), driving important Service Quality initiatives and process improvements across GS. You will connect the Regional Service Units, Global Service Operations, and other stakeholders on key quality topics — sharing best practices, driving common standards, and creating transparency. Balancing global, strategic initiatives with selective, hands-on regional support, you will help ensure quality programs are successfully implemented and that sustainable improvements — measured by non-conformance costs (NCC) and customer satisfaction (NPS) — are achieved.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Act as a reliable, competent point of contact for RSU on quality topics, hurdles, and questions, ensuring RSU interests are considered in EQS decision-making.
* Enable the RSU QM community by providing the support needed to successfully implement quality programs and achieve measurable, sustainable improvements in Service Quality.
* Drive global focus-area initiatives — Customer Excellence / NPS, Service CAPA, and Process Management — in alignment with RSU needs, EQS stakeholders, and process owners.
* Support and govern prioritized improvement projects across regions, and global functions, ensuring visible, customer-felt impact.
* Foster process implementation, harmonization, and comparability of results across RSUs to reduce complexity and boost efficiency.
* Act proactively based on data — leverage dashboards, KPIs, and AI-supported insights to identify focus areas and accelerate decisions.
* Identify global, systemic issues and initiate targeted, cross-regional improvement actions, applying structured problem-solving and continuous-improvement methods.

* Provide transparency through structured reporting, and maintenance of relevant frameworks (e.g., Hoshin Kanri, Quality DoR)

What You Bring

* Experience applying continuous improvement and problem-solving methodologies (e.g., Lean Six Sigma, root-cause analysis) across multiple organizations.
* Affinity for digitalization and AI to make quality and process knowledge more accessible and processes smarter (e.g., SEPH, BIC Cloud, and related tools).

* Proactive, self-driven, and customer-centric mindset, balancing global strategic goals with pragmatic regional support.

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

The following part-time (65% = 25.025 hours/week) position is to be filled as of October 1, 2026, in the Department of Epileptology of the University Hospital Bonn:

PhD Position (m/f/d)

The position is limited to 3 years.

The PhD position is focusing on pathomechanisms in autoantibody-associated neurological syndromes and autoimmune encephalitis and and supported by a grant from the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG). I will focus on the question whether (1) intracellular autoantibodies contribute causally to encephalitis, rather than acting as mere passive biomarkers and how (2) patient-derived Abs from autoantibody-positive encephalitis patients with different neurological presentations affect neuronal function using cultured neurons to assess cellular uptake, enzyme activity, neurotransmitter release and changes in neuronal plasticity.

This research is based on a wide array of methods including in vitro (e. g. Pitsch et al., 2020, PMID: 32196746) and mouse models (viral vector gene transfer/transgenic, EEG/video recordings) approaches, cell biological, molecular, biochemical, histological as well as imaging techniques (e. g. Pitsch et al., 2021, PMID: 33368582). A better understanding of the molecular and functional consequences of intracellular autoantibodies will have direct implications for better therapies aimed at interfering with autoimmune encephalitis by using pathway-specific pharmaceuticals or gene therapy.

Interested candidates should send curriculum vitae, letter of motivation indicating starting date, short description of past lab experience, copies of university degree(s) with academic records, contact information and at least two reference letters (or the referee’s contact info).
